stage1Hint1: Count the cells between the robot and the star.
stage1Hint2: How many cells must you travel to reach the star?
stage2Hint1: Look at where the walls are.
stage2Hint2: At which cell should you change direction to reach the star?
stage3Hint1: Follow the path the robot can travel.
stage3Hint2: How many bends are there, and which way does each bend turn?
stage4Hint1: Look at the direction the robot is facing.
stage4Hint2: When turning at the first cell, is the star to the robot’s right or left?
stage5Hint1: Count the cells along the straight path.
stage5Hint2: You need the same block several times, but can only use two blocks. What could you do?
stage6Hint1: Look at how the staircase shape repeats.
stage6Hint2: How many blocks make one stair step? How many times does that action repeat?
stage7Hint1: Look at the shape of the path.
stage7Hint2: Have you found the action for one side? How many times should you do it?
stage8Hint1: Look at the cells left between the end of the stairs and the star.
stage8Hint2: Is there anything left to do after the repeat ends?
